decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster system builds on the firm's established coolant offer, faces growing industry demand, and after one year shows no shortfall against aspirations, so slack supports keeping it.

The coolant cleaning centrifuge is an incremental extension of the firm's coolant management capabilities, and with industry turnover growing and no evidence of below-aspiration results, management keeps the product.

Coolant nozzles fit the existing service and distribution channels, and although they are a smaller consumable, slack and the lack of a performance shortfall justify retaining them while results remain uncertain.
The scraper belt chip conveyor is close to the firm's established conveyor line, has low uncertainty, and likely meets aspiration given the favourable industry environment, so it is kept.
The magnetic belt chip conveyor leverages existing engineering and customer relationships, and without any reported shortfall relative to aspirations the firm maintains it.
The hinged belt chip conveyor is a close variant of the firm's established conveyor offerings, performs satisfactorily, and is retained with low drop probability.
